newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel B up 5.71 pct on earnings news.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel B up 5.71 pct on earnings news.

text.p: San Miguel Corp B gained six pesos, or 5.71 percent, to 111 pesos in early trade on Thursday on its 1996 earnings news, brokers said.

"It was within expectation and with the lower costs of raw materials it seems certain that the company will register a better performance this year relative to last year," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities Inc.
San Miguel Corp reported on Wednesday a 6.09 billion peso net income in 1996, four percent up from 1995's 5.84 billion pesos.
"There's a lot of buying on B shares by fund managers and people are positioning on San Miguel's 1997 performance," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities Inc.
San Miguel A shares also rose by 1.50 peso, or 2.70 percent, to 57 pesos in early trade.
Early in the session, a total of 367,910 San Miguel B shares were traded along with 653,100 of the A shares.
